nodes.v: Three parts that behave like a real tooth

A dental implant has a titanium or zirconium post that sits in your jawbone the way a tooth root does, an abutment on top of it, and the crown that attaches to the abutment. In the weeks after surgery the post fuses with the bone, which is what makes the result stable rather than merely attached.
Placed into the jawbone using fully guided All-on-X technique, for accuracy and precision.
Seats on the post once it has integrated, and carries the tooth above it.
Matched to your face, skin tone and gum line, and finished in the practice's own lab.
Illustration, not a patient photograph. Planning is done on a 3D scan before surgery — digitally, rather than in the chair.

<script data-embed="section-js">
  /* ==========================================================================
   WZSR — the section runtime.

   Inlined into the <script> embed of every pasteable section. On the design
   pages the equivalent job is split across journey.js (defines WZ in <head>),
   journey-boot.js (registers plugins and flushes at the end of <body>) and
   five vendored GSAP files. A pasted section cannot rely on any of that: the
   requirement is that it renders and behaves on ANY Webflow page with zero
   page-settings changes, so whatever it needs it has to bring.

   Three things follow from that, and they are the whole design of this file:

   1. It must be safe to include N times. Every section on a page carries its
      own copy. The first one to run wins and the rest attach to it, so GSAP
      is fetched once and WZSR is defined once no matter how many sections
      are pasted or how many times the Designer duplicates one.

   2. Nothing may be global-by-assumption. Setup is handed the section element
      and every query is rooted at it. Two copies of the same section on one
      page each animate themselves.

   3. ScrollSmoother is deliberately absent. It needs a #smooth-wrapper >
      #smooth-content pair wrapping the whole document, which a pasted section
      has no right to create and no way to guarantee. ScrollTrigger works
      without it; the page simply scrolls natively.
   ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  if (window.WZSR) return;

  /* Overridable so the same section can be verified offline against the
     vendored copy, and so the client can self-host GSAP as Webflow site
     assets later without the sections being repackaged. Set
     window.WZSR_CDN before the first section's embed runs. */
  var CDN = window.WZSR_CDN || 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/';
  var FILES = ['gsap.min.js', 'ScrollTrigger.min.js', 'SplitText.min.js'];

  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var pending = [];
  var ready = null;

  function load(src) {
    return new Promise(function (res, rej) {
      var existing = document.querySelector('script[data-wzsr="' + src + '"]');
      if (existing) {
        if (existing.getAttribute('data-loaded') === '1') return res();
        existing.addEventListener('load', function () { res(); });
        existing.addEventListener('error', rej);
        return;
      }
      var s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = src;
      s.async = false;                 // order matters: plugins need the core
      s.setAttribute('data-wzsr', src);
      s.onload = function () { s.setAttribute('data-loaded', '1'); res(); };
      s.onerror = rej;
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
  }

  /* GSAP may already be on the page — a Webflow site can carry its own copy,
     and pasting a second one would re-register plugins over the first. */
  function ensure() {
    if (ready) return ready;
    ready = (window.gsap && window.ScrollTrigger)
      ? Promise.resolve()
      : FILES.reduce(function (p, f) { return p.then(function () { return load(CDN + f); }); }, Promise.resolve());
    return ready.then(function () {
      if (!window.gsap || !window.ScrollTrigger) throw new Error('GSAP unavailable');
      /* registerPlugin is idempotent in GSAP, but guard anyway so a host page
         that already registered them does not get a second pass. */
      if (!WZSR._registered) {
        gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
        if (window.SplitText) gsap.registerPlugin(SplitText);
        WZSR._registered = true;
      }
    });
  }

  /* ---------- the WZ surface the chapter scripts are written against ------ */

  function splitLines(el, build) {
    if (!el || !window.SplitText) return null;
    try {
      var opts = { type: 'lines', mask: 'lines', linesClass: 'wz-line', autoSplit: true };
      if (build) opts.onSplit = function (self) { return build(self); };
      return (SplitText.create ? SplitText.create(el, opts) : new SplitText(el, opts));
    } catch (e) {
      try { return new SplitText(el, { type: 'lines', linesClass: 'wz-line' }); }
      catch (e2) { return null; }
    }
  }

  function splitWords(el) {
    if (!el || !window.SplitText) return null;
    try {
      var opts = { type: 'words', wordsClass: 'wz-word' };
      return (SplitText.create ? SplitText.create(el, opts) : new SplitText(el, opts));
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  /* One continuous left-to-right sweep, white then accent. The accent run
     starts at the handover word rather than at a constant, so copy length
     cannot desynchronise the two. Returns { end, tail }. */
  function sweepWords(tl, el, vars) {
    vars = vars || {};
    var accent = vars.accent || '#03c5ec';
    var tailN = vars.tail == null ? 5 : vars.tail;
    var step = vars.step || .3;
    var dur = vars.duration || step * 2.4;
    var at = vars.at || 0;

    var sp = splitWords(el);
    var words = (sp && sp.words && sp.words.length) ? sp.words : null;
    if (!words) {
      var fb = Math.max(2, dur);
      tl.from(el, { opacity: .2, ease: 'none', duration: fb }, at);
      return { end: at + fb, tail: at + fb * .6 };
    }
    var cut = Math.max(0, words.length - tailN);
    var body = words.slice(0, cut), tail = words.slice(cut);
    var tailAt = at + cut * step;
    if (body.length) tl.to(body, { color: '#ffffff', stagger: step, duration: dur, ease: 'none' }, at);
    if (tail.length) tl.to(tail, { color: accent, stagger: step, duration: dur, ease: 'none' }, tailAt);
    return { end: at + (words.length - 1) * step + dur, tail: tailAt };
  }

  function headline(el, vars) {
    vars = vars || {};
    if (!el) return null;
    var start = vars.start || 'top 84%';
    var split = splitLines(el, function (self) {
      return gsap.from(self.lines, {
        yPercent: 108, duration: 1.05, stagger: .085, ease: 'power4.out',
        scrollTrigger: vars.trigger === false ? null : { trigger: el, start: start }
      });

    if (pin) { pin.style.height = 'auto'; pin.style.minHeight = '0'; pin.style.paddingBlock = 'clamp(3rem,6vw,5rem)'; }
    if (!track) return;

    if (bar) {

        var max = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;
        bar.style.transform = 'scaleX(' + (max > 0 ? track.scrollLeft / max : 0).toFixed(4) + ')';

  /* ---------- behaviours that must work with or without GSAP -------------- */

  function behaviours(root) {
    /* Office hours. Real Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00 America/Denver — the practice is
       not a 24-hour service and no section may imply it is. */
    var stat = root.querySelectorAll('[data-status]');
    var swap = root.querySelectorAll('[data-status-swap]');
    if (stat.length || swap.length) {
      var open = false;
      try {
        var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
          timeZone: 'America/Denver', weekday: 'short', hour: 'numeric', minute: 'numeric', hour12: false
        }).formatToParts(new Date());
        var get = function (t) { var p = parts.find(function (x) { return x.type === t; }); return p ? p.value : ''; };

        if (t) t.textContent = open ? 'Open now' : 'Closed · Mon–Fri 8–5';

      if (!box) return;
      var steps = Array.prototype.slice.call(box.querySelectorAll('.quiz__step'));
      var live = box.querySelector('[data-quiz-live]');
      var fill = box.querySelector('.quiz__progress i');
      var out = box.querySelector('[data-quiz-answers]');
      var answers = {}, idx = 0;
      function show(n) {
        idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(steps.length, n));
        steps.forEach(function (s, i) { s.setAttribute('data-active', String(i === idx)); });
        box.classList.toggle('is-done', idx >= steps.length);
        if (fill) fill.style.width = Math.round((idx / steps.length) * 100) + '%';
        if (live) live.textContent = idx >= steps.length
          ? 'All questions answered. Please leave your details.'
          : 'Question ' + (idx + 1) + ' of ' + steps.length;
      }
      steps.forEach(function (step) {
        var name = step.getAttribute('data-name');

          if (field) field.classList.toggle('is-bad', bad);
